items.name: button
items.title: VFX UI Anime Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <vfx-button>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime button is a standalone custom element. Load /components/button/index.js with a plain script tag (not a module), then use the <vfx-button> element. See components/button/README.md for attributes, properties, events, behavior, and limits.
